name: semantic-search-phase3c-holdout-v1
instructions: Judge corpus answerability first, then each returned image against the criterion. Near-match queries require the stated approximation; no-match queries should have no relevant corpus image.

queries.text: 石墙前的白色石狮子
queries.criterion: 一只白色石狮雕像清晰可见，背景为石墙或城墙。

queries.text: 铺满鲜花的古城门
queries.criterion: 传统城门或城墙入口前有大片鲜花装饰。

queries.text: 男人站在水边撒网
queries.criterion: 人物站在水边，正在抛出或展开渔网；仅仅持竿不算。

queries.text: 花栗鼠趴在木桌边看着瓜子
queries.criterion: 花栗鼠位于木质桌面或长椅边，旁边能看到瓜子或食物碎屑。

queries.text: 山路像细线一样盘绕在荒山上
queries.criterion: 远景中公路沿裸露山坡明显弯曲或盘绕。

queries.text: 一排挂在摊位上的彩色项链
queries.criterion: 多条彩色项链、挂饰或吊坠成排悬挂在摊位上。

queries.text: 湖边孤零零的一棵树
queries.criterion: 一棵树是湖岸画面的主要前景主体；允许远处出现其他小树。

queries.text: 窗内咖啡桌正对着巨大的山景
queries.criterion: 室内桌椅透过大窗面对显著的山峰景观。

queries.text: 睡在草地上的小鹿
queries.criterion: 幼鹿或有斑點的鹿蜷伏、躺臥在草地上。

queries.text: 白鶴站在綠色濕地裡
queries.criterion: 白色或黑白長腿鶴類站在綠草、蘆葦或濕地中。

queries.text: 荷葉散落在藍色池塘中
queries.criterion: 藍色水面上分布著多片清晰可見的荷葉或睡蓮葉。

queries.text: 木棧道筆直穿過樹林
queries.criterion: 木製棧道形成明顯直線，兩側或前方是樹林。

queries.text: 黃色花海後方是連綿山丘
queries.criterion: 大片黃色花田位於前景，後方可見山丘或山脊。

queries.text: 小鳥停在金屬扶手上
queries.criterion: 一隻小鳥明確停棲在金屬欄杆、扶手或管狀構件上。

queries.text: A ferry tied beside a concrete pier
queries.criterion: A passenger boat or ferry is stationary immediately beside a visible pier or quay.

queries.text: A white bird skimming the water with its reflection below
queries.criterion: A predominantly white bird is flying or taking off just above water and its reflection is visible.

queries.text: A single rice ear glowing green in sunlight
queries.criterion: A close, isolated green or yellow-green rice seed head is the clear subject.

queries.text: A spotted deer standing between white birch trunks
queries.criterion: A spotted deer stands among multiple pale or white tree trunks.

queries.text: A cow resting beside a dirt track
queries.criterion: A cow is lying down directly beside or partly on an unpaved path.

queries.text: A mountain peak framed by a dark roof ornament
queries.criterion: A dark architectural roof ornament or finial occupies the foreground with a mountain peak behind it.

queries.text: A road vehicle rounding a wet forest curve
queries.criterion: A car is driving on a visibly wet, curving road bordered by trees.

queries.text: A bee buried inside a vivid pink flower
queries.criterion: A bee is visibly inside or on the central petals of a saturated pink or magenta flower.

queries.text: A group of black waterbirds swimming together
queries.criterion: At least three dark or black waterbirds are together on the water.

queries.text: A turquoise ribbon of water squeezed between sheer canyon walls
queries.criterion: A narrow turquoise river or lake runs between steep, rocky mountain walls.

queries.text: A boat alone on open blue water
queries.criterion: A boat is the main isolated subject on blue water; a nearby shore is acceptable if the boat remains visually isolated.

queries.text: A crowded pedestrian market beneath red wooden balconies
queries.criterion: People walk through a traditional commercial street with prominent red or warm wooden upper structures.

queries.text: 白色 crane 在草地上昂着头
queries.criterion: 一隻長腿、長頸的鶴類站在草地上，頭頸清晰可見。

queries.text: mountain café 透过落地窗看雪峰
queries.criterion: 咖啡館或室內座位透過大型玻璃窗面向雪山或高山。

queries.text: 雨後 forest road 上有一輛 white car
queries.criterion: 白色汽車行駛在潮濕道路上，道路兩側有樹林。

queries.text: 藍色 lake 上成群 black birds
queries.criterion: 藍色水面上有一群至少三隻深色水鳥。

queries.text: 古城 gate 前鋪著 colorful flowers
queries.criterion: 古城門或城牆入口前有明顯的多彩花卉佈置。

queries.text: yellow flower field 配遠方 mountain ridge
queries.criterion: 黃色花田與遠處山脊同時清楚可見。

queries.text: 地铁列车驶入地下站台
queries.criterion: 地铁列车和地下站台必须同时清晰可见。

queries.text: 海灘上撐著一排彩色遮陽傘
queries.criterion: 沙灘上有多把打開的彩色遮陽傘。

queries.text: A red sports car parked beneath city skyscrapers
queries.criterion: A red sports car and tall urban skyscrapers must both be visible.

queries.text: A bowl of ramen with chopsticks on a restaurant table
queries.criterion: A prepared bowl of ramen and chopsticks are visible on a dining table.

queries.text: 夜晚 city skyline with neon skyscrapers
queries.criterion: A nighttime skyline dominated by multiple illuminated modern skyscrapers.

queries.text: An astronaut floating outside a space station above Earth
queries.criterion: An astronaut, exterior spacecraft structure, and Earth from orbit are all visible.
